terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms govern purchases made on DOOM | دوم by customers in the Sultanate of Oman.
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or placing an order you accept these terms. They apply to every sale made through the website and apps of DOOM | دوم. The commercial registration details and registered address of the operating company are displayed in the footer and on every receipt once registered.
terms.s2Body: Prices are shown in Omani rials (OMR) with three decimals. A product without a confirmed price or without available stock cannot be ordered. Taxes, when applicable, are shown on the receipt according to the configuration in force at the time of purchase.
terms.s3Body: An order is confirmed only after the payment has been confirmed by the payment provider or verified by our finance team. Items are reserved for a limited time while you pay; an unpaid order is cancelled automatically when the reservation expires. Payment methods that are not available are shown as such and cannot be selected.
terms.s4Body: Delivery fees and estimated times depend on your zone and on the capacity configured for it; both are shown before payment. Handover is confirmed with a one-time code given by you to the courier, together with the receiver's name and a photo kept as proof of delivery. Check the parcel at handover and report any visible damage to the courier and to support.
terms.s5Body: Instalment plans of 3, 6 or 12 months carry no interest and no fees; the total equals the cash price. Each application requires verified identity and is subject to approval. The schedule is shown before you accept the plan; missed instalments may suspend access to new plans.
terms.s6Body: Wallet balances come only from confirmed payments, approved refunds or gift cards whose value has been verified and actually received by our finance team. A gift card is never credited on the basis of a code or screenshot alone.
terms.s7Body: We are responsible for delivering products that conform to their description. We are not liable for delays caused by events beyond our reasonable control, nor for indirect losses, to the extent permitted by law. Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014).
terms.s8Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman. Contact support first so we can find a solution; you may also refer a complaint to the Consumer Protection Authority. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the competent courts of the Sultanate of Oman.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how DOOM | دوم collects and protects personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law of the Sultanate of Oman (Royal Decree 6/2022) and its Executive Regulation.
privacy.s1Body: The operating company of DOOM | دوم is the controller of the personal data processed through the website and apps. Our data protection contact can be reached through customer support from your account.
privacy.s2Body: Account data (name, email, mobile number, preferred language), delivery addresses and optional GPS position, orders and payments, support conversations, security data (sessions, sign-in attempts) and, only if you request enhanced verification, identity documents (ID card front and back, selfie).
privacy.s3Body: To create and secure your account, process orders, payments, deliveries and refunds, provide support, verify identity for DOOM FLEX, prevent fraud and meet our legal obligations. Identity documents are processed only with your explicit consent given when you submit them.
privacy.s4Body: Documents are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM before storage in private storage. Only authorised reviewers can open them; every access is recorded in an access log. Rejected or superseded documents are deleted after the retention period set by our compliance team.
privacy.s5Body: Our couriers (name, phone, delivery address), payment providers (the data needed to process a payment), a financing partner if one is used for DOOM FLEX, and public authorities when the law requires it. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s6Body: Some technical providers (hosting, storage) may process data outside the Sultanate. Such transfers take place only under the conditions of the Personal Data Protection Law and with appropriate safeguards.
privacy.s7Body: Account data is kept while your account is active. Invoices and payment records are kept for the period required by commercial and tax law. Identity documents are kept only as long as necessary for verification and then deleted.
privacy.s8Body: You may request access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction, a copy in a usable format, and withdraw your consent at any time — from Account → Security (deletion request) or through support. We answer within the time limits set by law.
privacy.s9Body: Passwords are hashed (bcrypt), sessions are protected cookies, access is role-based and sensitive actions are audited. If a breach affects your data, we will notify you and the competent authority as required by law.
privacy.s10Body: If you believe your data is not handled correctly, contact us first through support. You may also lodge a complaint with the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology, the authority responsible for personal data protection.

returns.title: Returns, refunds & warranty
returns.intro: If a product does not meet your expectations, arrives damaged or develops a fault, here is how we handle it.
returns.s1Body: Open a support request from the order page, choose the order and explain the reason. Add photos if the item or the packaging is damaged.
returns.s2Body: The product must be complete, with its accessories, manuals and original packaging. The return period and any exceptions are those stated on the product page and in your order confirmation, without prejudice to your legal rights.
returns.s3Title: Damaged or wrong item at delivery
returns.s3Body: Inspect the parcel when the courier hands it over. Report visible damage or a wrong item immediately to support; the proof of delivery recorded at handover helps us process your request quickly.
returns.s4Body: Returned products are inspected to confirm their condition and completeness before a refund or replacement is approved.
returns.s5Body: Approved refunds are credited to your DOOM Wallet or to the original payment method when the provider supports it. The timing of a card refund depends on the payment provider and your bank.
returns.s6Body: The warranty period of each product is shown on its page and on your receipt when the manufacturer or seller provides one. It covers manufacturing defects; it does not cover accidental damage, misuse or repairs by unauthorised third parties.
returns.s7Body: For hygiene or security reasons, some products cannot be returned once their seal is broken (for example in-ear earbuds) and activated digital codes cannot be refunded, unless they are defective.
